name: facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/features/frcnn/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.run_feature_extraction: run the FeatureExtractor to extract FRCNN features from images in a directory and save to output folder
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.build_detection_model: build a GeneralizedRCNN detection model from a pretrained model file and config using _build_detection_model
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.extract_frcnn_features: extract FRCNN object detection features from a list of image paths using get_frcnn_features
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.process_features: process raw FRCNN features by filtering confidence thresholds and extracting ROI features via _process_features
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.save_features: save extracted features as numpy arrays to the output folder using _save_feature

facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.load_labels: load Visual Genome object and attribute labels from objects.txt and attributes.txt files into lists
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.load_checkpoint: load a Detectron2 pickle checkpoint file and convert numpy arrays to PyTorch tensors
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.Config_from_pretrained: create a Config object from a pretrained model name or path by loading its config.yaml
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.cached_path: download and cache a remote URL or resolve a local file path with optional archive extraction
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.get_data: fetch data from a local file or remote URL and parse it into a Python object

facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.build_frcnn_model_from_pretrained: build a GeneralizedRCNN model from a pretrained checkpoint using from_pretrained with a config path
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.run_frcnn_inference: run object detection inference on images using GeneralizedRCNN to get boxes, classes, and ROI features
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.build_resnet_backbone: build a ResNet backbone network from a config using build_backbone with specified depth and norm
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.create_box2box_transform: create a Box2BoxTransform to compute deltas between source and target bounding boxes for regression
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.generate_rpn_anchors: generate anchors for region proposal using AnchorGenerator with configurable sizes and aspect ratios

facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.build_preprocess_images: build a python module that uses Preprocess to resize, normalize, and pad images for Faster R-CNN feature extraction
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.create_preprocess_call: create a function that calls Preprocess on a list of images and returns padded tensors with scale factors
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.test_preprocess_pad: test the Preprocess pad method to verify images are padded to uniform size and stacked into a tensor
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.refactor_scale_box: refactor the _scale_box function to scale bounding box coordinates by a given yx scale factor
facebookresearch_mmf/tools/scripts/featu.review_clip_box: review the _clip_box function that clamps bounding box coordinates to valid image dimensions
